title: physics-loop: Block22 exact POVM and radial live-to-Record writer
science: Three compatible terminals. (1) EXACT-BLOCK09-SIX-QUBIT-POVM-LIFT: the fourteen Block09 direction/corner product-state probabilities lift to a UNIQUE strictly positive complete POVM on the full 64-dimensional six-qubit space — E_{delta e_i} = I/12 + (tau/4) sum eps (delta_ij - 1/3) sigma, E_c = I/16 + (3tau/32) sum eps c_j c_k sigma with tau=1/24; sum_b E_b = I_64 exactly (6/12 + 8/16 = 1 with every Pauli coefficient cancelling); spectra strictly positive with axis effects in [1/18, 1/9] and corner effects in [(8-3sqrt2)/128, (8+3sqrt2)/128]; uniqueness is tomographic (four one-qubit densities span {I,sigma_x,sigma_y,sigma_z}, sixfold products have rank 4^6=4096 and span the whole algebra) — explicitly a uniqueness statement for the displayed law, NOT a Born-rule derivation. Explicit positive square roots sqrt(E_b) = sum_z sqrt(lambda_b(z)) prod P_{b,n,z_n} are constructed term by term and verified by exact Walsh inversion (constant and six linear coefficients reproduce the effects, all order-2-through-6 products vanish) — an operator certificate, not an abstract dilation. (2) COVARIANT-PRIMITIVE-M2-RADIAL-POINTER-LUEDERS-WRITER-FROM-LIVE-INPUT: an explicit radius-four CPTP instrument K_(f,b) = sqrt(E_b) tensor |Locked_(f,b)><Ready_f| plus K_STOP = I_live tensor (I - P_ready), satisfying the operator Kraus identity on a 32-site block (6 live + 26 pointer: 6 front, 6 axis-outcome, 8 corner-outcome, 6 status) where EVERY site carries the same ordinary spin-half M_2(C) onsite action and the code possibilities are the relational radial projectors P_q(r) = (I + (-1)^q rhat.sigma)/2 with P_0(r) = P_1(-r) — no computational scalar-pointer site type, no role-dependent representation. Six Ready and 84 Locked words mutually orthogonal, five proper-cubic (f,b) orbits of sizes 6,6,24,24,24, exact branch-superoperator covariance Ad(Gamma_g) Phi_(f,b) Ad(Gamma_g)^-1 = Phi_(gf,gb), and append-once STOP identity on every Locked sector. (3) FORCING NEGATIVE, INFORMATIVE-BLOCK09-POVM-INCOMPATIBLE-WITH-COMPLETE-M2-RECORD-QND: if the nonselective channel sum_b Phi_b = Id, then since the identity Choi matrix |Omega><Omega| is rank one and each J(Phi_b) is positive, every branch Choi shares that one-dimensional support, so J(Phi_b) = q_b|Omega><Omega| and Phi_b = q_b Id — every branch map is scalar. Since every informative Block09 effect is nonconstant, NO instrument with these effects can leave an arbitrary unknown six-qubit input exactly unchanged, independent of the Lueders choice. The escape is executed as a control: a CNOT copies an arbitrary diagonal two-label Record distribution QND while dephasing a noncommuting superposition, so commuting orthogonal Record statistics remain a lawful QND route but complete arbitrary-M_2 preservation does not.
